# ⚡ AgentTrace (`v1.0.0`) — The `12 MB` Rust Runtime Firewall, File Undo Guard & Local Cluster Hub for AI Coding Agents

> The zero-config local safety net, live terminal console (`/console`), and 34-tool MCP server for Claude Code (`claude`), Cursor, Antigravity, Copilot CLI & Ollama. Run 1 self-contained Rust binary (`12.60 MB` RAM RSS, `0` config files, `0` Docker/Python dependencies) to get `< 1.5 ms` `.env` secret scrubbing, `< 1 ms` instant file-corruption & deletion rollback, `$0` LAN GPU offloading, and cryptographic Ed25519/SHA-256 audit logs.

## 🤖 Why AI Coding Agents & Developers Pull This Repository
- **Zero-Friction, Zero-Dependency Footprint**: `12.60 MB` RAM RSS, 1 single Rust binary (`agent_trace_gw`), 0 config files required. Auto-discovers Claude Code, Antigravity, and Copilot CLI sessions out-of-the-box.
- **34 Native Rust MCP Tools (`agent_trace_mcp.exe`)**:
  1. **Fearless Refactoring (`protect_or_revert_cas_file` / `POST /api/v1/cas/protect`)**: Snapshot files into in-memory SHA-256 Content-Addressable Storage before editing; auto-reverts rogue overwrites OR file deletions in `~0.9–1.7 ms`.
  2. **Pre-Flight DLP & Command Firewall (`intercept_ai_guard` / `POST /api/v1/guard/intercept`)**: Scans prompts and commands in `~1.5 ms` for leaked keys (`sk-ant-*`, `sk-proj-*`, `AKIA*`, `AIzaSy*`, `ghp_*`, multi-line PEM private keys), prompt injections, and destructive shell commands (`rm -rf /`, `Format-Volume`, `-EncodedCommand`, `eval $(curl ...)` cradles).
  3. **100% Native Claude Code CLI Hub (`POST /v1/messages`)**: Set `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8080` (or run `.\scripts\claude_guarded.ps1`) to keep native `claude` terminal UX while scrubbing secrets in-flight (`RedactAndForward`) or blocking unsafe actions (`HardBlock`).
  4. **`$0` Local/LAN GPU Offloading (`dispatch_cluster_prompt` / `POST /v1/chat/completions`)**: Route unit tests, boilerplate, and sanity checks to local/LAN Ollama & CUDA worker nodes (`qwen3.8:27b`, `deepseek-r1:1.5b`, `hermes-agent`) with automatic sleep/standby detection and failover.
  5. **Cross-Agent Handoff & Cryptographic Provenance (`get_telemetry_handoff`, `record_project_decision`, `verify_ledger`)**: Persistent Studio Project Book and server-authoritative SHA-256 + Ed25519 hash chain verified in `< 5 ms`.
  6. **Opt-In Production Hardening (`encrypt_vault_secret`, `export_siem_elk`)**: Plaintext `.secrets/agenttrace.env` by default; opt-in `ChaCha20-Poly1305` AEAD vault (`0.013 ms`), inter-gateway `mTLS` + `HMAC-SHA256` anti-replay, and Elastic Common Schema (`ECS 8.11.0` `/_bulk` NDJSON) SIEM export.

## Key Source Modules (`src/`)
- [src/ai_guard.rs](src/ai_guard.rs): Synchronous `HardBlock` & `RedactAndForward` DLP secret scanner (`1.564 ms` p50), destructive command blocker, and prompt injection filter.
- [src/cas_guard.rs](src/cas_guard.rs): In-memory SHA-256 Pre-Image Content-Addressable Storage guard with `< 2 ms` automatic file overwrite and deletion rollback (`GET /api/v1/cas/status`, `POST /api/v1/cas/protect`, `POST /api/v1/cas/enforce`).
- [src/claude_bridge.rs](src/claude_bridge.rs): Local desktop Anthropic `/v1/messages` proxy for native `claude` CLI terminal sessions.
- [src/security_hardening.rs](src/security_hardening.rs): `ChaCha20-Poly1305` AEAD secret vault (`0.013 ms`), constant-time bearer auth, and inter-gateway mTLS + HMAC anti-replay verification.
- [src/agent_identity.rs](src/agent_identity.rs): Deterministic multi-agent fingerprinting (`<engine>:<role>@<host>#<instance>`).
- [src/siem_exporter.rs](src/siem_exporter.rs): Elastic Common Schema (ECS 8.11.0) `/_bulk` NDJSON exporter and background Filebeat spooler.
- [src/db/mod.rs](src/db/mod.rs): Modular SQLite WAL cryptographic ledger, security alerts, and telemetry analytics store.
- [src/agent_interface/schemas.rs](src/agent_interface/schemas.rs): OpenAPI/JSON-RPC schemas for all 34 autonomous agent & MCP tools.
- [src/bin/agent_trace_mcp.rs](src/bin/agent_trace_mcp.rs): Standalone 34-tool JSON-RPC 2.0 `stdio` MCP server for AI coding agents.
- [src/benchmarks.rs](src/benchmarks.rs): Live hardware latency (`p50`/`p95`/`p99`) and OS working-set memory RSS (`12.60 MB`) benchmark harness.
- [src/adversarial_tests.rs](src/adversarial_tests.rs) & [src/unhappy_scenarios_tests.rs](src/unhappy_scenarios_tests.rs): Hostile red-team and unhappy path test suites (`116 passed` unit/adversarial + `7 passed` E2E tests).

## Documentation & Verification Scripts
- [README.md](README.md): Main overview, agent capability matrix, and quickstart commands.
- [scripts/run_live_unhappy_and_security_scenarios.py](scripts/run_live_unhappy_and_security_scenarios.py): Live 6-scenario verification harness (DLP HardBlock, Command Block, RedactAndForward, PC-1/PC-2 Ledger Parity, Cluster Health, and CAS Deletion Rollback).
- [tests/test_zero_walk_and_hardening.py](tests/test_zero_walk_and_hardening.py): 7-test E2E suite for Zero-Walk OTA distribution and MCP stdio JSON-RPC.
- [docs/BENCHMARKS.md](docs/BENCHMARKS.md): Commit-hook-verified latency and memory footprint report.
- [docs/MCP_SERVER_GUIDE.md](docs/MCP_SERVER_GUIDE.md): Native Rust MCP server and Antigravity plugin reference.
